The complete OpenAPI schema is assembled by the `get_openapi()` function in `fastapi/openapi/utils.py` (lines ~585–643+). This function:

- Builds the `info` object (title, version, summary, description, etc.)
- Iterates over all routes (and webhooks) via `routing.iter_route_contexts(routes)`, collecting fields with `get_fields_from_routes()`
- Computes flattened models and a model name map (`get_flat_models_from_fields`, `get_model_name_map`, `get_definitions`) to build shared `components/schemas`
- For each `APIRoute`, calls `get_openapi_path()` to generate the path item, merging results into the `paths` dict, and merging any security schemes/definitions into `components`
- Similarly builds a `webhooks` section from the app's webhook routes
- Returns the final `dict` representing the full OpenAPI document

This function is invoked from `FastAPI.openapi()` in `fastapi/applications.py` (the `openapi` method, around line 1070), which passes `self.routes`, `self.webhooks.routes`, and other app-level metadata (title, version, tags, servers, etc.) to `get_openapi()`, caches the result in `self.openapi_schema`, and returns it. This method is what the `/openapi.json` endpoint (registered in `FastAPI.setup()`) calls to serve the schema.
